examples.text: Let the person know you're concerned.
examples.translation: 让对方知道你关心他或她。
examples.speechText: Let the person know you're concerned.

examples.text: He thinks it is convenient to do so.
examples.speechText: He thinks it is convenient to do so.

examples.text: Many people love to collect things, but why?
examples.translation: 许多人喜欢收藏东西，但这是为什么呢？
examples.speechText: Many people love to collect things, but why?

examples.text: As the density of whales increased, their singing behaviors（behaviour的美式拼写behavior的复数形式） changed.
examples.translation: 随着鲸群密度增加，它们的歌唱行为发生了变化。
examples.speechText: As the density of whales increased, their singing behaviors changed.

examples.text: A well-balanced diet that includes moderate portions from each of the major food groups can help ensure you’re getting the nutrition and nutrients that promote a stronger immune system.
examples.translation: 均衡饮食包含各主要食物类别的适量份量，有助于确保你获得增强免疫系统所需的营养。
examples.speechText: A well-balanced diet that includes moderate portions from each of the major food groups can help ensure you’re getting the nutrition and nutrients that promote a stronger immune system.

examples.text: Over 40 percent of the poor people are children.
examples.translation: 贫困人口中有超过40%是儿童。
examples.speechText: Over 40 percent of the poor people are children.

examples.text: The process will take about 14 to 16 months of weekly classes（class的复数形式） and testing.
examples.translation: 这个过程需要每周上课和接受测试，持续大约十四至十六个月。
examples.speechText: The process will take about 14 to 16 months of weekly classes and testing.

examples.text: Make sure that we exercise regularly.
examples.speechText: Make sure that we exercise regularly.

examples.text: Now, instead of taking several subjects（subject的复数形式）, you have chosen one major subject because you find it interesting and worth exploring further.
examples.translation: 现在，你不再同时学习好几个科目，而是选择了一门主要学科，因为你觉得它有趣，值得进一步探索。
examples.speechText: Now, instead of taking several subjects, you have chosen one major subject because you find it interesting and worth exploring further.

examples.text: Dunlop made an unexpected finding as whale numbers sharply rose following the end of commercial whaling (捕鲸).
examples.translation: 商业捕鲸结束后，鲸的数量大幅增加，Dunlop也因此有了一项意外发现。
examples.speechText: Dunlop made an unexpected finding as whale numbers sharply rose following the end of commercial whaling .

examples.text: Your average reply to a question should be about 20 seconds long.
examples.translation: 回答一个问题时，你的平均作答时长应在二十秒左右。
examples.speechText: Your average reply to a question should be about 20 seconds long.

examples.text: Students must also pay for room and board.
examples.translation: 学生还必须支付食宿费。
examples.speechText: Students must also pay for room and board.

examples.text: An emotionally hurt person may be overwhelmed by the details（detail的复数形式） of everyday life.
examples.translation: 一个情感上受到伤害的人，可能会被日常生活中的琐事压得不知所措。
examples.speechText: An emotionally hurt person may be overwhelmed by the details of everyday life.

examples.text: From then on, she spent a great deal of time in her bedroom writing.
examples.translation: 从那以后，她花了大量时间待在卧室里写作。
examples.speechText: From then on, she spent a great deal of time in her bedroom writing.

examples.text: The latter represents higher levels of comprehension.
examples.translation: 后者代表着更高层次的理解。
examples.speechText: The latter represents higher levels of comprehension.
